title: freeze-build
responsibility: Gives the browser run it belongs to its own checked copy of the finished build and prints where it is.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: The single line the script writes to stdout when the copy succeeds: the JSON of the FrozenBuild that frozenBuild returns, where build is the run's own copy of the build, buildId is the 64-character SHA-256 identity shared by the source before and after the copy and by the copy, and files is the number of files in the build. On failure nothing is written to stdout, and the message goes to stderr instead.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by e2eFixtures when HARNESS_E2E_ROOT is unset or empty, which means the process belongs to no browser run and nothing is copied; the script prints the message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by frozenBuild before anything is copied, when the source directory cannot be listed or holds no file, which means no build is there; the script prints the message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem error from removing the target, copying the build or reading the build's files, which frozenBuild neither catches nor cleans up after; the script prints its message to stderr and exits with status 1.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by frozenBuild when the copy, or the source identified after the copy, does not have the buildId the source had before the copy, so the source is reported as changed while it was copied. frozenBuild removes the copy before throwing, and the script prints the message to stderr and exits with status 1.
